canonical_source.title: Munda Tribe Perception Towards Livelihood Through Sustainable Development
canonical_source.provider: Problemy Ekorozwoju / Problems of Sustainable Development
canonical_source.author_affiliation_reported: Department of Humanities and Social Sciences, Indian Institute of Technology (ISM), Dhanbad, Jharkhand, India

scope.classification: empirical/social-science candidate; not authority for universal or timeless cultural claims

identity_verification.canonicalization_note: DOI landing page, PDF/index records and citations must be treated as manifestations of one work, not independent corroboration.

promotion.reason: Abstract-level metadata is verified, but proposition-level promotion requires authoritative full text, exact page/table/section locators, study design/sample/locality verification, and rights/consent review.

rights_access_consent.rule: Public discoverability or readability is not redistribution permission.

required_before_promotion: obtain and hash an authoritative full-text manifestation where lawful
verify journal-to-PDF pagination and bibliographic metadata
inspect sampling, field locality, dates, participant characteristics and methodology
extract only supported propositions with exact page/table/section locators
separate participant evidence, authors' interpretation and cited secondary claims
review copyright/reuse terms and participant/cultural-governance constraints
avoid generalizing a bounded sample to all Munda communities
audit_principle: No cultural claim is promoted from abstract language alone.
